# AMD FSR1 / FSR2 / FSR3.1 upscalers + FSR3 frame interpolation (IFrameGen).
# Compiles the FidelityFX SDK host components, the VK backend and the shared
# support sources directly into this static lib.
# Shader permutation headers under ffx_permutations/ are pre-generated by
# gen_permutations.sh (checked in; mirrors the SDK's own CMake shader build).
set(FFX_DIR ${SR_THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/fidelityfx)

add_library(upscaler_fsr STATIC
    FsrUpscaler.cpp
    Fsr3FrameGen.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/components/fsr1/ffx_fsr1.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/components/fsr2/ffx_fsr2.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/components/fsr3upscaler/ffx_fsr3upscaler.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/components/opticalflow/ffx_opticalflow.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/components/frameinterpolation/ffx_frameinterpolation.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/shared/ffx_assert.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/shared/ffx_message.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/shared/ffx_object_management.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/shared/ffx_breadcrumbs_list.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/shared/ffx_shader_blobs.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/shared/blob_accessors/ffx_fsr1_shaderblobs.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/shared/blob_accessors/ffx_fsr2_shaderblobs.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/shared/blob_accessors/ffx_fsr3upscaler_shaderblobs.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/shared/blob_accessors/ffx_opticalflow_shaderblobs.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/shared/blob_accessors/ffx_frameinterpolation_shaderblobs.cpp
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/vk/ffx_vk.cpp
)
sr_common_setup(upscaler_fsr)
target_compile_definitions(upscaler_fsr PRIVATE SR_SHADER_DIR="${SR_SHADER_OUT_DIR}/")

sr_compile_shader(FSR1_UNJITTER_SPV fsr1_unjitter.comp)
add_custom_target(fsr_shaders DEPENDS ${FSR1_UNJITTER_SPV})
add_dependencies(upscaler_fsr fsr_shaders)

# Select the compiled-in effects for ffx_shader_blobs.cpp dispatch.
target_compile_definitions(upscaler_fsr PRIVATE FFX_FSR1 FFX_FSR2 FFX_FSR3UPSCALER FFX_FI FFX_OF)

# SDK include layout:
#   include/                -> <FidelityFX/host/...>, <FidelityFX/gpu/...>
#   src/shared              -> <ffx_object_management.h> (component sources)
#   src/components          -> "fsr1/ffx_fsr1_private.h" (blob accessors)
#   src/backends/shared     -> <ffx_shader_blobs.h>, <ffx_breadcrumbs_list.h> (vk backend)
#   ffx_permutations/       -> generated <ffx_*_pass*_permutations.h>
target_include_directories(upscaler_fsr SYSTEM PRIVATE
    ${FFX_DIR}/include
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/shared
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/components
    ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/shared
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ffx_permutations)

# The SDK sources are third-party code; relax warnings on MSVC.
if(MSVC)
    set_source_files_properties(
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/components/fsr1/ffx_fsr1.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/components/fsr2/ffx_fsr2.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/components/fsr3upscaler/ffx_fsr3upscaler.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/components/opticalflow/ffx_opticalflow.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/components/frameinterpolation/ffx_frameinterpolation.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/shared/ffx_assert.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/shared/ffx_message.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/shared/ffx_object_management.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/shared/ffx_breadcrumbs_list.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/shared/ffx_shader_blobs.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/shared/blob_accessors/ffx_fsr1_shaderblobs.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/shared/blob_accessors/ffx_fsr2_shaderblobs.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/shared/blob_accessors/ffx_fsr3upscaler_shaderblobs.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/shared/blob_accessors/ffx_opticalflow_shaderblobs.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/shared/blob_accessors/ffx_frameinterpolation_shaderblobs.cpp
        ${FFX_DIR}/src/backends/vk/ffx_vk.cpp
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "/W0")
endif()
